notes: All arithmetic wraps modulo 2^64; zero iterations return seed without data access.
Work counts one semantic update or load per iteration, not executed instructions. Actual loop work determines the returned state.
The ordinary allocated load supplies bit zero; add 3 when set, otherwise add 5.
CSEL uses flags from TST; both nontrapping integer alternatives use non-flag-setting ADD before selection. Counter flags are separate.
MCA intentionally omitted: a straight-line extract does not model the data-dependent branch-path mixture. Fixed driver data does not establish branch predictability.
Index is (state >> 8) & mask, scaled by eight; mask 255 and 256 words bound the final 8-byte load to offsets 2040..2047. Data pointer and mask remain unchanged.
